_note: Anting-anting: Filipino folk amulets. One equipped at a time. Each has a perk and a small cost. mods keys: parry_zone (added to the parry window), max_hp_mult, damage_taken_mult, energy_per_perfect (added), heal_on_perfect, counter_bonus (added counter damage). The first amulet arrives in Episode 2, chosen from two.

amulets.name: Buhok ng Tikbalang
amulets.text: A strand of tikbalang mane. Wider parry window, but it takes more of your health.

amulets.name: Batong Buhay
amulets.text: A living stone. Each perfect parry steadies you, but the window is a little tighter.

amulets.name: Mutya ng Ulan
amulets.text: A pearl of rain-water. Perfect parries charge the watch faster, but blows land harder.

amulets.name: Tanikala
amulets.text: A chain link blessed at Quiapo. Counters cut deeper, but the window narrows.
